events.title: NVIDIA/Model-Optimizer

brief.headline: NVIDIA Model-Optimizer bundles compression techniques for faster inference
brief.newly_possible: You can apply quantization, distillation, pruning and speculative decoding from one library, then deploy to TensorRT-LLM or vLLM.

Smaller models fit more modest hardware
Compression steps become a standard part of model release

hats.product: Lower inference cost can improve margins on model-backed features.
